name: taskbridge-for-clickup
description: Browser extension to create ClickUp tasks from Gmail
author: Leandro Iramain

scripts.build:release: npm run build && node scripts/build-release.js && node scripts/validate-release.js && node scripts/package-release.js
scripts.build:release:chrome: npm run build && node scripts/build-release.js --target=chrome && node scripts/validate-release.js --target=chrome && node scripts/package-release.js --target=chrome
scripts.build:release:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/build-release.js --target=firefox && node scripts/validate-release.js --target=firefox && node scripts/package-release.js --target=firefox
